brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Single full hex base (piece:0,0,0;full) with solid top cover (cover:0,0,0;full;top) and six side end caps (cap:0,0,0;*;30/90/150/210/270/330) forming fully enclosed cell; lockJoints applied

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so board can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port louvre hex-port-louvre installed at slot 0 (port:0#0,0#0) on side wall - vents without letting rain in per catalog use

finish.summary: Built 1-cell closed hex enclosure with solid top cover and all 6 side caps, with hex-port-louvre on one face to provide breathing/ventilation. Staged with bench electronics props (PSU, multimeter, solder reel) to show electronics use.

events.text: Your vented enclosure is up next — I'll build a closed, breathing housing for the board.

result.note: A cover goes on an open top or side face of a base. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
